system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
**ADVICE – PROJECT KESTREL: SELLER’S UPDATED SPA & DISCLOSURE LETTER**  
*Prepared for Wattlebridge Holdings deal team. All analysis below is measured against the Buyer Negotiation Playbook (baseline 25 % / AUD 6 M cap, 24-month general claims period, specific fair disclosure, no blanket knowledge bars, fundamental warranties outside the general regime, fraud carve-outs, Bluefen & Riverlark hard conditions, DD-005 bonuses in funds flow, Ironquay IP broadened, Title independently evidenced, Tax/IP open).*

---

### 1. MATERIAL DEPARTURES FROM PLAYBOOK & REQUIRED PUSHBACK

| # | Issue | Seller Position | Playbook Requirement | Departure & Reasoning | Pushback Required |
|---|-------|-----------------|----------------------|----------------------|-------------------|
| **1** | **General Warranty Cap** (Cl. 12.1) | 20 % / AUD 4.8 M | 25 % / AUD 6 M baseline; 20 % only with **Amelia Frost written authority identifying this draft** – none given. | Seller has unilaterally moved to the conditional fallback without approval. Cap is 20 % below baseline. | Reject 20 %; insist on 25 % / AUD 6 M. Document that no Frost authority exists. |
| **2** | **De Minimis & Basket** (Cl. 12.2) | De minimis AUD 25 K; basket AUD 250 K (excess-only recovery) | De minimis AUD 5 K; basket AUD 50 K (first-dollar recovery once exceeded). | Seller’s thresholds are 5× and 5× higher; excess-only basket shifts risk to Buyer. | Demand playbook thresholds. No compromise without Frost sign-off. |
| **3** | **General Claims Period** (Cl. 12.3/13) | 18 months | 24 months baseline; 18 months only with Frost written approval – none given. | Seller treats 18 months as agreed. Cuts Buyer’s window by 25 %. | Insist on 24 months. |
| **4** | **Fundamental / Title Warranties** | Subject to same caps, baskets, time limits as general warranties | Separate regime: 100 % cap, ≥ 6 years, outside general basket/de minimis/knowledge bar. | Seller collapses fundamental protections into the weakened general regime. Title/capacity claims would be capped at AUD 4.8 M and time-barred at 18 months. | Non-negotiable: separate fundamental regime per playbook. |
| **5** | **Fraud / Wilful Concealment / Deliberate Misconduct Carve-outs** (Cl. 9.3, 12.8, 20.5) | Limitations, exclusive remedy, non-reliance apply to **all claims of any nature** | Carved out of **all** caps, baskets, time limits, exclusive remedies, non-reliance to maximum enforceable extent. No waiver permitted. | Seller’s drafting would bar fraud claims via exclusive-remedy/non-reliance clauses. Unacceptable. | Insert express carve-outs; confirm non-waivable. |
| **6** | **Disclosure Standard** (Schedule 7 / Disclosure Letter §1.1–1.2) | General disclosure of entire data room (DD-002 to DD-012) + public registers + statutory registers | **Specific fair disclosure only**; reject whole-data-room, public-register, prudent-search deemed disclosure. | Seller’s “general disclosure” sweeps thousands of pages; Buyer cannot rely on specific warranties. Disclosure Letter §1.4 also tries to disclaim materiality/breach. | Require specific, page/paragraph-level disclosure letter. Delete general disclosure clauses. |
| **7** | **Buyer Knowledge Exclusion** (Cl. 8.3) | No claim for any matter Buyer or advisers “had knowledge” of, including matters “discoverable” from data room/public records | Delete blanket buyer-knowledge exclusions. Any knowledge qualifier requires **named Seller knowledge persons + reasonable enquiry**. Never excuses title, capacity, fraud, specific indemnity. | Seller imposes constructive-knowledge bar tied to data room – effectively a “buyer beware” regime. | Strike Cl. 8.3. If Seller insists on knowledge qualifier, limit to actual knowledge of named Buyer individuals after reasonable enquiry; carve out fundamental warranties, fraud, specific indemnities. |
| **8** | **Bluefen Consent** (Cl. 3/6.3) | Seller uses “reasonable endeavours”; consent deemed satisfied on delivery of counterparty’s written consent | **Effective consent + evidence conditions satisfied before Completion**. Reasonable endeavours alone insufficient for material customer consent. | DD-002 shows Bluefen ~30 % revenue; Cl. 11.2/11.3 conditions not yet satisfied. Seller offers no proof of satisfaction. | Condition Precedent: written Bluefen consent + certified evidence all Cl. 11.3 conditions met. No “reasonable endeavours” fallback. |
| **9** | **Riverlark Facility** (Cl. 2/7) | Release to be provided **following Completion** (~AUD 3.2 M outstanding) | **Current payout + direct repayment from Completion funds + effective security releases** at Completion. Post-completion release only with irrevocable undertaking + Frost approval. | Seller leaves AUD 3.2 M debt + security in place post-Completion; no irrevocable undertaking disclosed. Buyer inherits refinancing risk. | Completion funds flow must show Riverlark payout + security discharges. If Seller resists, require irrevocable escrow undertaking + Frost sign-off. |
| **10** | **Employee Bonuses (DD-005)** | AUD 420 K conditional bonuses “matter for Seller”; **not itemised in funds flow** | Specific line item or Seller-funded; on-costs (payroll tax, super) included; funds flow must not silently exclude. | Disclosure Letter §5 confirms bonuses omitted from funds flow; on-costs unaddressed. Creates hidden post-Completion liability. | Insert specific funds-flow line for AUD 420 K + on-costs, funded by Seller (price adjustment or escrow). |
| **11** | **Ironquay IP Indemnity** (Cl. 11.1) | Limited to SOW3 payment (AUD 180 K open per DD-010); “considered adequate” | Broaden narrow indemnity, preserve SOW3 cure; AUD 180 K **not independently verified**. | Seller refuses to broaden; DD-010 shows AUD 180 K unpaid, no bank verification, no confirmatory assignment. | Expand indemnity to cover IP ownership/encumbrance breaches beyond SOW3 payment; require independent payment verification or escrow holdback. |
| **12** | **Tax / IP Warranties** | “Settled under general regime above” | **Remain OPEN**; assume no unlimited liability and no resolution. | Seller attempts to close Tax/IP under the weakened general cap (AUD 4.8 M) and 18-month limit. | Confirm Tax/IP warranties subject to separate negotiation; do not accept general regime cap/time limits. |
| **13** | **Title Evidence** | DD-012 share register only | **Independent title/ownership/encumbrance/authority evidence**; DD-012 is internal source, not independent proof. | Seller treats internal register as conclusive. No ASIC search, no encumbrance certificates, no authority opinions. | Require independent legal opinion / ASIC extracts / encumbrance searches / certified board resolutions. |
| **14** | **Export/Privacy Incident (DD-006)** | “Preliminary operational matter, not expected material” | Preserve logs, investigate, require updates; assume **no confirmed breach, harm, notification duty or numeric demand**. | Seller downplays; investigation incomplete. Buyer needs ongoing disclosure obligation and post-Completion cooperation. | Insert specific covenant: Seller must continue investigation, preserve logs, provide written updates until closure; indemnity for any resulting liability (carved out of general caps). |
| **15** | **Sandbar Renewals (AUD 330 K)** | “Ordinary-course operating costs” | Assess; **no automatic Debt classification or price deduction**. | Aligned on “no automatic debt”, but Buyer must still assess materiality and timing. | Reserve right to adjust working capital if renewals not truly ordinary course / already accrued. |

---

### 2. DISCLOSURE LETTER – SPECIFIC RED FLAGS

| Disclosure § | Concern | Action |
|--------------|---------|--------|
| **1.1–1.2** (General disclosure) | Whole data room + public registers | Delete; require specific disclosure only. |
| **1.4** (Non-admission boilerplate) | Attempts to neutralise warranty liability | Strike; warranties stand on their own. |
| **2** (Bluefen) | No final consent, conditions unsatisfied | Make Bluefen consent a **Condition Precedent** with evidence. |
| **3** (Riverlark) | No repayment, no discharge | Completion funds flow must include payout + releases. |
| **4** (Ironquay) | AUD 180 K unpaid, no assignment proof | Escrow holdback or broadened indemnity. |
| **5** (Bonuses) | Omitted from funds flow, on-costs unknown | Specific funded line item in funds flow. |
| **6** (Export incident) | Investigation incomplete, scope unknown | Ongoing investigation covenant + indemnity. |
| **10** (Title) | Only internal register | Independent evidence required. |
| **11** (Reservation) | Seller reserves all positions | No effect; Buyer evaluates independently. |

---

### 3. SUMMARY OF RECOMMENDATIONS

1. **Cap & Thresholds** – Reject 20 % / AUD 4.8 M cap; hold at 25 % / AUD 6 M. Reject AUD 25 K de minimis / AUD 250 K excess-only basket; insist on AUD 5 K / AUD 50 K first-dollar.
2. **Claims Period** – 24 months general; 18 months only with Frost written authority (absent).
3. **Fundamental Warranties** – Separate regime: 100 % cap, ≥ 6 years, no basket/de minimis/knowledge bar.
4. **Fraud Carve-outs** – Express, non-waivable carve-outs from all caps, baskets, time limits, exclusive remedies, non-reliance.
5. **Disclosure** – Specific fair disclosure only; delete general data-room/public-register disclosure.
6. **Buyer Knowledge** – Strike blanket exclusion; any qualifier limited to actual knowledge of named individuals after reasonable enquiry; carve out fundamental warranties, fraud, specific indemnities.
7. **Bluefen** – Condition Precedent: written consent + certified satisfaction of Cl. 11.3 conditions.
8. **Riverlark** – Payout + security releases at Completion from funds flow; otherwise irrevocable escrow undertaking + Frost approval.
9. **DD-005 Bonuses** – Specific funded line item in funds flow (AUD 420 K + on-costs).
10. **Ironquay IP** – Broaden indemnity beyond SOW3 payment; require independent verification of AUD 180 K payment or escrow holdback.
11. **Tax/IP** – Keep open; do not accept general regime.
12. **Title** – Require independent evidence (ASIC, encumbrance searches, legal opinion).
13. **Export Incident** – Ongoing investigation covenant + indemnity carved out of general caps.
14. **Sandbar** – Assess in working capital; no automatic debt treatment.
15. **Funds Flow** – Revise to reflect Items 8, 9, 10 above.

---

### 4. NEXT STEPS

- **Mark-up SPA** with the above redlines; circulate to Seller with cover note referencing playbook baselines.
- **Request Frost written authority** if any fallback positions are contemplated (none
=== END ADVICE ===
